topic: Xbox Series X|S powered on with no TV signal: HDMI path checks, low-resolution boot and HDMI port damage
record_type: Draft on branch claude/tips-xbox-no-signal, awaiting owner approval before merge to main
uniqueness: 71-guide inventory checked. No Xbox guide existed; console group held only PlayStation and Nintendo. Mirrors the PS5 no-signal pattern, which gained early impressions in the September Search Console review, and ties to the listed Series X|S HDMI port repair.
scope: Series X, Series S and Series X Digital that power on while the TV shows no signal. Power faults and in-game black screens excluded.

sources.retrieval: Official page is a JavaScript app; article text could not be read from this environment. Steps cross-checked against two independent write-ups that reproduce them.
Linked for power cycling; the one-minute unplug is the page's own conservative instruction, not attributed to Xbox.
Read. Power + Eject (disc) or Power + Pair (Series S and Series X Digital), release after second beep about 10 seconds later, 640 x 480.
Read. Same Series X sequence and TV & display options path.
